tagline.en: Port Arthur to Choteau, broken by Yellowstone, through Fort Worth, Denver and Laramie
tagline.zh: 从阿瑟港到乔托，被黄石公园一分为二，途经沃思堡、丹佛与拉勒米

start.en: US 89 at Choteau, Montana, about 100 miles south of the Canadian border
start.zh: 蒙大拿州乔托，与 US 89 相接，距加拿大边境约 100 英里

end.en: US 69 and US 96 at Port Arthur, Texas, a few miles up the Sabine from the Gulf
end.zh: 得克萨斯州阿瑟港，与 US 69、US 96 相接，距墨西哥湾数英里

en: US 287 is a branch of US 87 that grew longer than most main routes. It leaves the Gulf at Port Arthur, runs north-west through the East Texas pine country by Woodville and Palestine to Corsicana and Ennis, crosses the Dallas–Fort Worth area on the Fort Worth side, and heads out across the Red River plains by Wichita Falls, Vernon and Childress to Amarillo. It crosses the Oklahoma Panhandle at Boise City and runs up the eastern edge of Colorado through Springfield, Lamar and Limon into Denver, then north along the Front Range through Longmont, Loveland and Fort Collins.

In Wyoming it becomes a mountain road: over the high plains to Laramie and Rawlins, north-west through Lander and Dubois, over Togwotee Pass with US 26 to Moran, and up through Grand Teton National Park to Yellowstone's south entrance. There it stops. The park's roads are unnumbered, and US 287 resumes at the west entrance in West Yellowstone, Montana, running north by Ennis, Three Forks, Townsend and Helena to its end at Choteau on the Rocky Mountain Front.
zh: US 287 是 US 87 的一条支线，却比大多数主线还长。它在阿瑟港离开墨西哥湾，向西北穿过得克萨斯东部的松林地带，经伍德维尔与巴勒斯坦到科西卡纳与恩尼斯，从沃思堡一侧穿过达拉斯—沃思堡地区，再经威奇托福尔斯、弗农与奇尔德雷斯越过红河平原到达阿马里洛。它在博伊西城穿过俄克拉何马狭长地带，沿科罗拉多东缘经斯普林菲尔德、拉马尔与利蒙进入丹佛，再沿落基山前缘北上，经朗蒙特、拉夫兰与柯林斯堡。
进入怀俄明后，它成为一条山区公路：越过高原到拉勒米与罗林斯，向西北经兰德与杜波依斯，与 US 26 一同翻越托格沃蒂山口到莫兰，再穿过大提顿国家公园到黄石公园南门。路线就此中断。公园内的道路没有编号，US 287 在蒙大拿州西黄石的公园西门重新开始，北行经恩尼斯、三岔、汤森与海伦娜，止于落基山前缘的乔托。

en: Its Wyoming core is the oldest part. The road through Rawlins had carried a branch of the 1926 US 87 system — English Wikipedia calls it US 87W — and when US 87 was moved east through Cheyenne in the mid-1930s that branch became US 287. The dates are not settled: US Ends gives 1934 for the change, while English Wikipedia dates the commissioning of US 287 from Yellowstone to Denver to 1939 and its extension to Port Arthur to 1940. Texas's designation file already describes the whole Texas route, from the Oklahoma line to Port Arthur, in a minute order of 26 September 1939. English Wikipedia also records that in Texas it absorbed the earlier US 370 between Amarillo and Bowie.

The Montana segment came last. Montana numbered the corridor from West Yellowstone to Choteau as state highway 287 in about 1957, and after earlier refusals by AASHO and lobbying by the U.S. Highway 287 Association the federal designation was extended over it in 1965.

Proposals to make the road an Interstate recur. A 2017 Texas bill to study upgrading US 287 in Texas died in committee. In May 2026 Senator John Cornyn introduced a federal bill to upgrade the route and rename it Interstate 47.
zh: 它在怀俄明的核心路段最为古老。经过罗林斯的这条路原本承载着 1926 年 US 87 体系的一条支线——英文维基百科称之为 US 87W；1930 年代中期 US 87 东移改经夏延后，这一支成了 US 287。具体年份并无定论：US Ends 记为 1934 年，英文维基百科则把 US 287 自黄石至丹佛一段的编定定在 1939 年、延伸至阿瑟港定在 1940 年。得克萨斯的编号档案在 1939 年 9 月 26 日的一份决议中，就已记载自俄克拉何马州界至阿瑟港的整条得州路线。英文维基百科还记载，它在得克萨斯接收了阿马里洛至鲍伊之间原有的 US 370。
蒙大拿段最后加入。蒙大拿约在 1957 年把西黄石至乔托的走廊编为 287 号州道；在 AASHO 此前数次拒绝、“287 号美国国道协会”持续游说之后，1965 年联邦编号延伸覆盖了这段路。
把它升级为州际公路的提议屡次出现。2017 年，得克萨斯一项研究 US 287 得州段升级的法案在委员会中夭折。2026 年 5 月，参议员约翰·科宁提出联邦法案，拟升级本路线并更名为 47 号州际公路。

en: The stretch most often in the news is the two-lane road between Fort Collins and Laramie, a commuter and freight route over the state line. A Colorado Department of Transportation report of 2023 found above-average crash rates; on the 30 miles from north of Fort Collins to the Wyoming line there had been 570 crashes, 15 of them fatal, since 2019, and at least 15 University of Wyoming students had died on the road since 2000.

Wyoming is widening its end in stages. In May 2026 WYDOT began a $7.1 million project, about 90 per cent federally funded, to widen 2.5 miles south of Laramie from two lanes to five. Two further sections towards the Colorado line, 6.6 and 5.1 miles, are in the state improvement programme for reconstruction as four-lane divided highway, with construction pencilled in for 2031 and 2032.
zh: 最常见诸报端的是柯林斯堡与拉勒米之间的双车道路段，它是一条跨州的通勤与货运道路。科罗拉多交通部 2023 年的一份报告发现，这里的事故率高于平均水平；自柯林斯堡以北至怀俄明州界的 30 英里内，2019 年以来发生 570 起事故，其中 15 起致命；2000 年以来，至少有 15 名怀俄明大学学生死于这条路。
怀俄明正分期拓宽本州一端。2026 年 5 月，怀俄明交通部启动一项 710 万美元、约 90% 由联邦出资的工程，把拉勒米以南 2.5 英里由双车道拓宽为五车道。通往科罗拉多州界的另外两段（6.6 英里与 5.1 英里）已列入州交通改善计划，拟改建为四车道分隔公路，暂定于 2031 与 2032 年施工。

why.en: No figure exists. US 287 was assembled from 1939 onwards out of roads already built, including the former US 370 and US 87 branches, and has been rebuilt piecemeal by five states.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 287 自 1939 年起由既有道路拼合而成，包括原 US 370 与 US 87 的支线，此后由五个州分段陆续改建。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state pays for its own projects with state and federal-aid money; the WYDOT widening south of Laramie, for example, is about 90 per cent federal and 10 per cent state.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州以州资金与联邦补助支付各自工程；例如拉勒米以南的拓宽工程约 90% 由联邦、10% 由州出资。

value.en: $7.1 million for about 2.5 miles widened to five lanes, contract to McGarvin-Moberly Construction, work begun 4 May 2026 with completion due by 30 November 2026
value.zh: 710 万美元，将约 2.5 英里拓宽为五车道，承包商为 McGarvin-Moberly 建筑公司，2026 年 5 月 4 日开工，合同完工期 2026 年 11 月 30 日

figures.source: WYDOT, Transportation Commission contract awards, January 2026, and construction notice, May 2026; Laramie Boomerang, May 2026

label.zh: 拉勒米至科罗拉多州界改建

value.en: Two sections of 6.6 and 5.1 miles added to the programme in November 2025 for reconstruction as four-lane divided highway, with preliminary engineering budgeted at $2.62 million and $2.925 million; construction costs not yet programmed
value.zh: 两段（6.6 英里与 5.1 英里）于 2025 年 11 月列入计划，拟改建为四车道分隔公路，初步设计预算分别为 262 万与 292.5 万美元；施工费用尚未编列

figures.source: WYDOT, State Transportation Improvement Program, FY 2026 first-quarter update

value.en: 503.898 miles certified as open to traffic (2010 figure); the designation describes the Texas route as approximately 768 miles including its overlaps with US 87, US 81, US 75 and US 69
value.zh: 认证通车里程 503.898 英里（2010 年数据）；编号说明称得州路线约 768 英里，含与 US 87、US 81、US 75、US 69 的共线路段

figures.source: TxDOT Transportation Planning and Programming Division, highway designation file, US 287

why.en: No current authoritative figure: AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and has published no national log since 1989. English Wikipedia gives 1,791 miles but cites no source.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数字：AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，1989 年后未再发布全国里程表。英文维基百科给出 1,791 英里，但未注明来源。

why.en: Five states count their own sections, and the range runs from urban arterials in Fort Worth and Denver to the two-lane road through the Wind River country. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 五个州各自统计本州路段，差异从沃思堡、丹佛的城市干道到风河地区的双车道公路不等。并无合并数字发布。

value.en: 570 crashes, 15 of them fatal, on the 30 miles from north of Fort Collins to the Wyoming line since 2019, from a 2023 CDOT report
value.zh: 据科罗拉多交通部 2023 年报告，自柯林斯堡以北至怀俄明州界的 30 英里内，2019 年以来发生 570 起事故，其中 15 起致命

conditionFigures.source: ESPN, 23 February 2024, reporting the CDOT study

timeline.en: A Texas Highway Commission minute order of 26 September describes US 287 from the Oklahoma line to Port Arthur; English Wikipedia dates the route's commissioning north of Denver to the same year.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，得克萨斯公路委员会的一份决议记载 US 287 自俄克拉何马州界至阿瑟港；英文维基百科也把丹佛以北路段的编定定在这一年。

timeline.en: US 287 is extended from West Yellowstone to Choteau, Montana, over what had been state highway 287.
timeline.zh: US 287 沿原 287 号州道自西黄石延伸至蒙大拿州乔托。

timeline.en: Texas redescribes US 287 after relocating it south of Ennis.
timeline.zh: 得克萨斯在恩尼斯以南改线后，重新描述 US 287 的走向。

timeline.en: A Texas bill to study upgrading US 287 to an Interstate dies in committee.
timeline.zh: 得克萨斯一项研究将 US 287 升级为州际公路的法案在委员会中夭折。

timeline.en: A CDOT report finds above-average crash rates between Fort Collins and the Wyoming line.
timeline.zh: 科罗拉多交通部报告发现，柯林斯堡至怀俄明州界之间的事故率高于平均水平。

timeline.en: WYDOT begins widening US 287 south of Laramie in May; the same month a bill is introduced in the U.S. Senate to make the route Interstate 47.
timeline.zh: 5 月，怀俄明交通部开始拓宽拉勒米以南的 US 287；同月，美国参议院有人提出法案，拟将本路线改为 47 号州际公路。
